newsitem.title: MOROCCO: French PM Juppe expected to postpone Morocco visit.
newsitem.headline: French PM Juppe expected to postpone Morocco visit.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe is expected to put off his scheduled official visit to Morocco in May following the decision to hold a snap general election in France, a Moroccan official said on Tuesday.
French President Jacques Chirac on Monday called an early parliamentary election which will be held in two rounds on May 25 and June 1.

"With the unexpected legislative elections in France which coincide with the timing of Juppe's visit to Morocco, we beleive he will delay it...But at this stage we have received no official notice on the issue," the official added.
Juppe had been expected in Rabat for a three-day visit from May 13.

France is Morocco's main commercial partner with total annual trade of more than $1 billion. More than 720,000 Moroccan expatriates live in France while 25,000 French nationals are residents in Morocco.
